# Temple Scroll Column 52 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 52 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**52:1** And behold, he has brought charges, saying: I did not find the tokens of virginity in your daughter — but here are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the garment before the elders of the city.

**52:2** Then the elders of that city shall take the man and punish him.

**52:3** And they shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman's father, because he gave an evil name to a virgin of Israel; and she shall be his wife, and he may not divorce her all his days.

**52:4** But if the charge is true, and the tokens of virginity were not found for the young woman,

**52:5** then they shall bring the young woman out to the entrance of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death, because she committed an outrage in Israel by acting as a harlot in her father's house; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.

**52:6** If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, both of them shall die — the man who lay with the woman, and the woman herself; so you shall purge the evil from Israel.

**52:7** If a young woman who is a virgin is betrothed to a man, and another man finds her in the city and lies with her,

**52:8** then you shall bring both of them out to the gate of that city and stone them to death — the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he violated his neighbor's wife; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.

**52:9** But if the man finds the betrothed young woman in the open field, and the man seizes her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die.

**52:10** But to the young woman you shall do nothing; the young woman has committed no offense deserving of death; for this is like the case of a man who rises against his neighbor and murders him.

**52:11** For he found her in the open field; the betrothed young woman cried out, but there was no one to rescue her.

**52:12** If a man finds a young woman who is a virgin and who is not betrothed, and he seizes her and lies with her, and they are discovered,

**52:13** then the man who lay with her shall give fifty shekels of silver to the young woman's father, and she shall become his wife, because he has violated her; he may not divorce her all his days.

**52:14** A man shall not take his father's wife and shall not uncover his father's garment.

**52:15** No one who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall enter the assembly of the LORD.

**52:16** No one of illegitimate birth shall enter the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation, none of his descendants shall enter the assembly of the LORD.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 52 continues Deuteronomy 22:17-23:2. "Tokens of virginity" maintained for betulim. "Purge the evil" for bi'arta ha-ra' — the standard Deuteronomic formula. "Emasculated by crushing or cutting" follows standard scholarly rendering of Deut 23:1. "Illegitimate birth" for mamzer — the precise legal status rather than the English pejorative.*
